purpose: Rust Coach 人设与表达一致性调研
method: 官方域名搜索、AnySearch code.doc 检索辅助发现、httpx 读取最终官方页面正文；摘录从正文获得，未使用搜索摘要作为结论依据。
limitations: 这是公开文档研究，不是对厂商内部生产系统的审计。
文档会更新；记录短摘录和最终 URL，未归档整页或宣称固定发布日期。
厂商接口能力不能视为当前 OpenAI-compatible 代理服务已支持，需独立兼容性验证。
方案中的字段协议、错误码、指标门槛和排期是本项目设计，不是来源中的标准或已测结果。

sources.title: Prompt engineering
sources.excerpt: Identity: Describe the purpose, communication style, and high-level goals of the assistant.
sources.additional_excerpt: Version prompts in code Store production prompts in your application code instead of creating reusable prompt objects.
supports: 显式身份、指令、示例、上下文分段
提示词代码版本化与测试
sources.application: 版本化 policy 与按任务编译的提示，不让历史对话决定核心人设。

sources.title: Increase output consistency
sources.excerpt: Use system prompts to set the role: Use system prompts to define Claude’s role and personality.
sources.additional_excerpt: Prepare Claude for possible scenarios: Provide a list of common scenarios and expected responses in your prompts.
supports: 结构化输出与任务分解
sources.application: 定义被偷家、缺条件、角色诱导、工具失败等情况下仍保持一致的教练行为。

sources.title: Building effective agents
sources.excerpt: workflows offer predictability and consistency for well-defined tasks
supports: 可定义任务使用工作流
复杂度与成本需要收益支撑
sources.application: 保留现有图与工具结果，不为人设额外构建多 Agent 或无限重写循环。

sources.title: Write agent instructions
sources.excerpt: An agent can't act on instructions to use tools, knowledge sources, other agents, or topics it doesn't have.
sources.additional_excerpt: Ensure that any instructions you give your agent are grounded in capabilities and knowledge you configured
supports: 指令应与真实配置能力一致
sources.application: 从实际配置生成能力描述，不虚构实时观察、游戏执行或状态保存。
sources.access_note: HTML 顶部有授权提示，但公开正文可读取；结论只引用实际读取的正文。

sources.title: Content builder
sources.excerpt: Brand instructions ( instructions on Managed Deep Agents, or memory files on the SDK) for always-on voice and research rules
supports: 稳定注入的品牌表达规范
身份与写作行为的显式配置
sources.application: 借鉴固定加载的表达契约，不直接使用其 subagent、文件系统或持久记忆架构。
sources.qualification: 该教程明确系统指令文件不同于 durable memory；不要把人设规范与自动学习的用户记忆混淆。

sources.title: Evaluation concepts
sources.excerpt: Offline evaluations Use offline evaluations for pre-deployment testing
sources.additional_excerpt: Online evaluations Use online evaluations for production monitoring
supports: 人工、代码、LLM-as-judge 与成对评审
sources.application: 按事实、行动性、风格分别评估，坏例回流到可复现测试。

sources.title: Composite evaluators with the SDK
sources.excerpt: uses three evaluators—summary, tone, and formatting—to assess the output
supports: 内容、语气和格式分项评价
sources.application: 采用分项评价，改为事实硬门槛；不照搬示例中的加权平均来掩盖严重错误。

sources.title: Evaluation best practices
sources.excerpt: Maintain agreement: Use human feedback to calibrate automated scoring.
sources.additional_excerpt: Challenges : Position bias (response order), verbosity bias (preferring longer responses)
sources.application: 随机顺序、长度控制、人工复核；不得以单模型自评分代替验收。
